assets.name: Mangueira
assets.brief: Broad asymmetric dome canopy of long lance-shaped dark green leaves, warm forked trunk visibly joining branches, a few hanging ripe golden-orange mangoes with red blush, elongated fruit silhouettes; mature mango tree.

assets.name: Jabuticabeira
assets.brief: Upright branching pale cinnamon trunk with distinct clusters of small round deep purple-black jabuticaba fruit ATTACHED TO TRUNK AND THICK BRANCHES, not hanging from leaf tips. Rounded layered crown, small oval leaves.

assets.name: Laranjeira
assets.brief: Compact rounded glossy green crown, recognizable round orange fruits attached within foliage in small uneven groups, slim branched brown trunk. Warm orange tree with restrained fruit count.

assets.name: Limoeiro
assets.brief: Slightly irregular open lime-green crown, elongated oval yellow lemons with pointed tips attached to branches, a few darker unripe fruits, slender leaning forked trunk, readable gaps.

assets.name: Goiabeira
assets.brief: Open spreading canopy of broad oval veined matte green leaves, smooth mottled cinnamon trunk bifurcating low, sparse round-pear-shaped yellow-green guavas with tiny star-shaped calyx tips; no sliced fruit.

assets.name: Aceroleira
assets.brief: Low multi-branched small tree with airy rounded lobed crown, small glossy oval leaves, groups of three red-orange distinctly three-lobed acerola cherries attached to slender branches, thin tan trunk.

assets.name: Cajueiro
assets.brief: Broad low asymmetric spreading crown, thick crooked brown trunk, rounded broad leaves. Only six clearly readable cashew apples orange-red pear shaped with a single small curved grey cashew nut attached underneath EACH fruit. Natural connected silhouette.

assets.name: Pitangueira
assets.brief: Compact airy asymmetric tree, small pointed oval green leaves with tiny copper new leaves, scattered hanging scarlet ribbed pumpkin-shaped Surinam cherries (pitangas), slender branching reddish-brown trunk.

assets.name: Amoreira
assets.brief: Spreading slightly angular canopy of broad serrated green leaves, a few elongated purple-black bumpy mulberries and two red unripe berries hanging from twigs, sturdy branched warm grey-brown trunk.

assets.name: Caramboleira
assets.brief: Airy layered canopy of pinnate compound leaves with paired small oval leaflets. Sparse long golden yellow starfruit with five prominent longitudinal ridges, hanging naturally; no sliced fruit, no floating stars. Light brown branching trunk.

assets.name: Bananeira
assets.brief: ONE banana plant with layered green pale pseudostem, eight huge arching broad paddle leaves with natural edge tears and clearly visible central veins, one attached hanging compact bunch of green-yellow bananas and a small burgundy flower under it. Whole plant roots visible, no pot.

assets.name: Coqueiro
assets.brief: One tall gently curved ringed tan coconut palm trunk, a crown of eight long arching feather-like fronds with many connected narrow leaflets, one attached cluster of four green coconuts directly below crown. Clearly visible trunk, elegant asymmetric silhouette, not banana leaves.
